name: undo
notes: btrfs snapshots around every apt/dpkg transaction, rollback, and self-healing boot (desos-undo). Inactive, with a clear message, in the live session and on non-btrfs installs. /etc/grub.d/42_desos-undo must stay executable; the installer must create the @ and @snapshots subvolumes (installer/calamares/modules/mount.conf). No package may own /.snapshots. See undo/README.md.
